Initial release of influencer-commerce-intel, providing comprehensive TikTok Shop creator commerce analytics.

- Enables real-time analysis of creator sales, product details, live sessions, and video ads on TikTok Shop.
- Guides users through commerce intelligence workflows with direct API operation mapping.
- Returns structured output: commerce summary, opportunity, risk, and next steps.
- Includes built-in quota management and clear user messaging when API call limits are reached.
- Offers CLI tooling and environment variable support for easy integration and operational flexibility.
